Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
Q: Do multiples of the same retainer/equipment grant cumulative
benefits, as a general rule?

If answer is no, ignore questions below.

Q: If you have 3 corpse minions and you burn a blood to gain intercept
do you gain +1 for EACH corpse minion (ie +3)?

Q: With 3 Faithful Servants, do you gain 3 blood when in torpor?

Q: With 3 Fortune Tellers in play, do you get to pick 3 cards at
random from prey's hand?
If so, must you replace and allow your prey to reshuffle between
each pick?

Q: Do 3 Marijava Ghouls give +3 stealth with presence actions?

Q: Do 3 Flak Jackets prevent up to 3 damage each combat?

Q: Do 3 IR goggles gain 3 optional maneuvers each combat?

Q: Can you burn 3 Vials of Garou Blood at once to gain +3 hand damage
and 3 additional strikes for the rest of combat?

Q: Do 3 Jackals (at superior) give you +6 stealth when your prey has
a ready Settite/Assamite?

Q: Do 3 Raven Spys (or 3 Raptors or 3 Revenants) gain one +3
intercept?

Q: Do 3 Raptors reduce your opponents hand size by 3?

Q: Do 3 Wolf Companions to 3 damage?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
jbwh...@dorsai.org (John Whelan) writes:
>Q: Do multiples of the same retainer/equipment grant cumulative
> benefits, as a general rule?

Yes.

>If answer is no, ignore questions below.

>Q: If you have 3 corpse minions and you burn a blood to gain intercept
> do you gain +1 for EACH corpse minion (ie +3)?

No. Each of them redundantly grants your vampire the ability to burn
blood for intercept. Having this ability more than once doesn't alter
the nature of the ability itself.

>Q: With 3 Faithful Servants, do you gain 3 blood when in torpor?

Yes.

>Q: With 3 Fortune Tellers in play, do you get to pick 3 cards at
> random from prey's hand?

Yes.

> If so, must you replace and allow your prey to reshuffle between
> each pick?

Yes.

>Q: Do 3 Marijava Ghouls give +3 stealth with presence actions?

Yes.

>Q: Do 3 Flak Jackets prevent up to 3 damage each combat?

Yes.

>Q: Do 3 IR goggles gain 3 optional maneuvers each combat?

Yes.

>Q: Can you burn 3 Vials of Garou Blood at once to gain +3 hand damage
> and 3 additional strikes for the rest of combat?

No. You cannot use more than one additional-strike-granting effect.

>Q: Do 3 Jackals (at superior) give you +6 stealth when your prey has
> a ready Settite/Assamite?

Yes.

>Q: Do 3 Raven Spys (or 3 Raptors or 3 Revenants) gain one +3
> intercept?

Yes.

>Q: Do 3 Raptors reduce your opponents hand size by 3?

Yes.

>Q: Do 3 Wolf Companions to 3 damage?

Yes.
